post.caption: Tiffany's April Fools jokes came true. On April 1, 2021, Tiffany joked that its blue was now yellow, then rebuilt its Rodeo Drive store in yellow, down to the boxes and shopping bags. On April 1, 2022, it announced its own cryptocurrency, TiffCoin, and the next day said TiffCoin was real, but not crypto. It was 499 numbered coins in 18 karat gold, echoing Tiffany Money, which customers once traded in for jewelry. Each coin cost 9,999 dollars in 2022.
